mapper.sql: select bd.batch_id as "batchId", bd.batch_type as "batchType", bd.schedule_cycle as "scheduleCycle", bd.max_execution_seconds as "maxExecutionSeconds", bd.owner_user_id as "ownerUserId", coalesce(kps.name, u.login_id, cast(bd.owner_user_id as varchar)) as "ownerName", bd.request_id as "requestId", bd.updated_at as "updatedAt", bd.updated_by as "updatedBy", coalesce(bp.parameter_json::text, '{}') as "parameterJson" from batch_definitions bd left join users u on u.user_id = bd.owner_user_id left join korus_personnel_snapshots kps on kps.employee_no = u.employee_no left join batch_parameters bp on bp.batch_id = bd.batch_id
mapper.select: order by bd.updated_at desc, bd.batch_id limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from users where user_id = #{userId}
select count(*) from batch_definitions where batch_id = #{batchId}
mapper.insert: insert into batch_definitions (batch_id, batch_type, schedule_cycle, max_execution_seconds, owner_user_id, request_id, created_by, updated_by) values (#{request.batchId}, #{request.batchType}, #{request.scheduleCycle}, #{request.maxExecutionSeconds}, #{request.ownerUserId}, #{requestId}, #{userId}, #{userId}) on conflict (batch_id) do update set batch_type = excluded.batch_type, schedule_cycle = excluded.schedule_cycle, max_execution_seconds = excluded.max_execution_seconds, owner_user_id = excluded.owner_user_id, request_id = excluded.request_id, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = excluded.updated_by

insert into batch_parameters (batch_id, parameter_json, request_id, created_by, updated_by) values (#{batchId}, CAST(#{parameterJson} AS jsonb), #{requestId}, #{userId}, #{userId}) on conflict (batch_id) do update set parameter_json = excluded.parameter_json, request_id = excluded.request_id, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = excluded.updated_by

insert into batch_dependencies (predecessor_batch_id, successor_batch_id, request_id, created_by, updated_by) values (#{predecessorBatchId}, #{successorBatchId}, #{requestId}, #{userId}, #{userId}) on conflict (predecessor_batch_id, successor_batch_id) do update set request_id = excluded.request_id, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = excluded.updated_by
mapper.select: select predecessor_batch_id from batch_dependencies where successor_batch_id = #{batchId} order by predecessor_batch_id
select successor_batch_id from batch_dependencies where predecessor_batch_id = #{batchId} order by successor_batch_id
